# Auto-generated by OpenHydroQual model compiler (Export to C++).
#
# Linux / macOS:
#   cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
#   cmake --build build
# Windows (Visual Studio 2022):
#   cmake -S . -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64
#   cmake --build build --config Release
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(Wetland LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

# The generated model header includes the header-only runtime by bare name.
set(OHQ_INC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime")

option(WETLAND_BUILD_SHARED "Build Wetland as a shared library (.so/.dll)" ON)
if(WETLAND_BUILD_SHARED)
  add_library(Wetland SHARED Wetland_api.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(Wetland PRIVATE WETLAND_EXPORTS PUBLIC WETLAND_SHARED)
else()
  add_library(Wetland STATIC Wetland_api.cpp)
endif()
target_include_directories(Wetland PUBLIC ${OHQ_INC})
set_target_properties(Wetland PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# tiny client: verifies the library links and runs
add_executable(Wetland_example example.cpp)
target_link_libraries(Wetland_example PRIVATE Wetland)
